summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. filed Form 6-K reporting results of its June 16, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. Shareholders voted to re-elect directors Sam Moed, Yael Margolin, and Adi Raviv; approved an amendment to increase authorized ordinary shares; ratified amendments to CEO Amir Reichman's employment agreement; approved RSU grants to Reichman and Chairman Mark Germain; and ratified Zvi Haft as auditor. No price, premium, or deal consideration was involved. This is a routine governance filing with no special-situation transaction.
